h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sikkim

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sikkim

items.pText: In Sikkim, a playground is often planned for a hotel lawn or a school terrace with a view of the mountains, and the site is rarely flat or large. FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, government campuses, town parks, hotels and homestays in Gangtok, Namchi, Pelling, Ravangla and other towns across the state.

Tourism shapes a lot of the demand. Families travelling with young children look for hotels with a safe outdoor play area, and a few well-chosen pieces on a lawn can serve that need. Schools want sturdier equipment for daily use by many children. We make everything at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and it reaches Sikkim by road through Siliguri. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, grouted on terraced ground or self-standing where the base is firm. Send us the measurements and photos of your site, and we will reply with equipment suggestions and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Play areas for hotels and homestays

c: A hotel play area needs to look good from the rooms and the dining area, take little space and stay safe without full-time supervision. Wooden structures from our
suit a hill setting, and a small spring rider and swing set covers younger guests. Fence the play area where a terrace drops away, and keep it away from the driveway.

items.q: How much space does a hotel play area need?
items.a: A swing, a slide and a spring rider can fit on a modest lawn once the safe play area around each piece is allowed for. Send the lawn or terrace measurements and we will mark the exact space on a drawing.

items.q: Which months suit playground installation in Sikkim?
items.a: Outside the heavy monsoon, when roads are more dependable and concrete can cure. Plan the order early so the play area is ready before the main tourist season.

items.q: Can wooden playground equipment handle the hill climate?
items.a: Our wooden and composite structures are made for outdoor use. In damp, cool weather, keep them clean, clear leaves and moss, and check fixings each season.
